initial.entityTitle: Loaned accessible reading device and specialist charging accessories
initial.description: The loaned reading device was returned with an intermittent power complaint and a bag of specialist charging accessories. The receiving team must retain the full intake note, including the requirement to erase locally stored reading material, count the separately packaged cable adaptors, and document the next custodian before any onward routing occurs.
initial.restockDetail: Return to stock is conditional on a successful power test as well as the completed intake checks. A later change to the power result must invalidate this route immediately.
initial.repairDetail: The specialist repair team can accept a device without a passed power test once the accessories and data checks are complete.
initial.recycleDetail: Approved material recovery is available after the same safe intake checks, with the complete chain-of-custody record attached.
